answer: Every agent that wants to trade must first dock at the shared wharf and earn a docking licence by doing real deliveries for an island community: each licence costs a 50-coin fee and 40 hours of verified carrying work, recorded on the wharf manifest. A sybil attacker who wants 200 fake identities must pay 10,000 coins and 8,000 hours of real work, and any licence caught with a forged manifest loses its 50-coin deposit. Over the horizon, licences expire and must be re-earned, so old clones cannot sit idle; faking an island of identities stays costlier than any reward the attack could steal.
